one_line: says which signals lead and which lag
premise_shape: In <domain>, <signal A> moves before <signal B> by <lag>, because <mechanism>.
falsifier: B moves first, or the stated lag fails
predict_frame: Report the current values of the leading and lagging signals and the observed gap. State what the lead predicts for the lagging signal, with a date.
assess_frame: Did the leading signal move first this period, and did the lag hold?
